summary.text: In their first innings, PUN reached 592 for 9 declared, with Sanvir Singh top-scoring with 205 runs off 375 balls while Kavuri Saiteja took 3 for 110. AP responded in their first innings with 505 for 8, led by Shaik Rasheed who scored 176 runs off 333 balls against Vihaan Malhotra, who claimed 2 for 47. The match ended in a draw.
